verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is itself a terminal coding agent. The docs show it querying and editing large codebases, debugging in natural language, and running from shell commands like `gemini --include-directories`. Hands-on users confirm running it against their own local directories and codebases, though several report agentic reliability problems such as edit failures and loops. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of local installation, consistent hands-on reliability of agentic edits, and clarity on the product's ongoing availability given community reports that it is being shut down.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: I have thrown very large codebases at this and it has been able to navigate and learn them effortlessly.
Gemini will happily open in my root directory.
